## Read in Data
```{r}
#add dates back into the data 
data = read.csv("")
```

```{r}
topic_info =  read.csv("") 
```

```{r}
#removing topics that were gibberish
data_cleaner = data |> filter(!(topic %in% c(-1))) |> select(-Unnamed..0)
#This decreased row count from 211335 to 93688
```

## Topic Names 

```{r}
topic_labels = topic_info |> select(Topic, Name)
```

```{r}
#merge with names 
full_data = data_cleaner %>% left_join(topic_labels, by = c("topic" = "Topic")) |> rename(topic_number = topic) |> rename(topic_name = Name)
```

```{r}
full_data %>%
  count(doc_id, topic_number) %>%
  group_by(doc_id) |>  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))
```


```{r}
# Convert article level 
# 1. build topic proportions (doc_id + topic_* columns only)
topic_props <- full_data %>%
  count(doc_id, topic_number) %>%
  group_by(doc_id) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(doc_id, topic_number, prop) %>%
  complete(doc_id, topic_number, fill = list(prop = 0)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = topic_number, values_from = prop, names_prefix = "topic_")

# 2. build article-level metadata (one row per doc_id, all your other columns)
article_meta <- full_data %>%
  group_by(doc_id) %>%
  summarise(across(-c(sentence), first), .groups = "drop") 

# 3. join them
article_df <- article_meta %>%
  left_join(topic_props, by = "doc_id")

head(article_df)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

data_longer <- article_df |> select(-topic_label) |>
  pivot_longer(
  cols = starts_with("topic_") & !matches("^topic_name$"),
   names_to = "category",
  values_to = "proportion" )

head(data_longer)
```

```{r}
#Newspapers
sun_npost = article_df |> filter(outlet %in% c("Sun", "NP")) |> 
  mutate(period = relevel(factor(period), ref = "Pre")) |>  mutate(outlet = relevel(factor(outlet), ref = "Sun"))

guardian_times = article_df |> filter(outlet %in% c("Guardian", "NYTimes")) |> 
  mutate(period = relevel(factor(period), ref = "Pre"))

ft_wsj = article_df |> filter(outlet %in% c("FT", "WSJ")) |>

#Countries 
full_pre_reference = article_df |>
  mutate(period = relevel(factor(period), ref = "Pre"))
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

sun_full    <- full_pre_reference |> filter(outlet == "Sun")
npost_full  <- full_pre_reference |> filter(outlet == "NP")


check_separation <- function(data, topic_col) {
  data |>
    group_by(period) |>
    summarise(n_nonzero = sum(.data[[topic_col]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    pull(n_nonzero) |>
    min() 
}

separation_flags <- tibble(
  topic = 0:13,
  min_nonzero_sun = sapply(0:13, function(i) check_separation(sun_full, paste0("topic_", i))),
  min_nonzero_np  = sapply(0:13, function(i) check_separation(npost_full, paste0("topic_", i)))
) |>
  mutate(
    needs_lpm_sun = min_nonzero_sun <= 2,   
    needs_lpm_np  = min_nonzero_np  <= 2
  )

print(separation_flags)


models_sun <- list()
models_np  <- list()

for (i in 0:13) {
  f <- as.formula(paste0("topic_", i, " ~ period"))

  use_lpm_sun <- separation_flags$needs_lpm_sun[separation_flags$topic == i]
  use_lpm_np  <- separation_flags$needs_lpm_np[separation_flags$topic == i]

  models_sun[[paste0("topic", i, "_sun")]] <- if (use_lpm_sun) {
    lm(f, data = sun_full)
  } else {
    glm(f, family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"), data = sun_full)
  }

  models_np[[paste0("topic", i, "_np")]] <- if (use_lpm_np) {
    lm(f, data = npost_full)
  } else {
    glm(f, family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"), data = npost_full)
  }
}


get_period_estimates <- function(model, outlet_label) {
  periods <- c("Pre", "Post")

  if (inherits(model, "lm") && !inherits(model, "glm")) {
    ## LINEAR PROBABILITY MODEL PATH (robust SEs)
    robust_vcov <- vcovHC(model, type = "HC1")
    b <- coef(model)

  
    est_pre  <- b[1]
    est_post <- b[1] + b[2]

    ci_pre  <- coefci(model, vcov. = robust_vcov)[1, ]


    data_post_ref <- model$model |>
      mutate(period = relevel(factor(period), ref = "Post"))
    f_post <- formula(model)
    model_post_ref <- lm(f_post, data = data_post_ref)
    ci_post <- coefci(model_post_ref, vcov. = vcovHC(model_post_ref, type = "HC1"))[1, ]

    tibble(
      outlet    = outlet_label,
      period    = periods,
      estimate  = c(est_pre, est_post),
      conf.low  = c(ci_pre[1], ci_post[1]),
      conf.high = c(ci_pre[2], ci_post[2])
    )

  } else {
    ## QUASIBINOMIAL GLM PATH
    pred <- predict(model, newdata = data.frame(period = periods),
                     type = "link", se.fit = TRUE)
    tibble(
      outlet    = outlet_label,
      period    = periods,
      estimate  = plogis(pred$fit),
      conf.low  = plogis(pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit),
      conf.high = plogis(pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit)
    )
  }
}



n_df <- bind_rows(
  sun_full   |> count(period) |> mutate(outlet = "Sun"),
  npost_full |> count(period) |> mutate(outlet = "NP")
)

topic_graphs   <- list()
topic_plot_dfs <- list()

for (i in 0:13) {
  sun_model   <- models_sun[[paste0("topic", i, "_sun")]]
  npost_model <- models_np[[paste0("topic", i, "_np")]]

  if (is.null(sun_model) || is.null(npost_model)) {
    warning(paste("Missing model for topic", i, "- skipping"))
    next
  }

  plot_df <- bind_rows(
    get_period_estimates(sun_model, "Sun"),
    get_period_estimates(npost_model, "NP")
  ) |> left_join(n_df, by = c("period", "outlet"))

  g <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = period, y = estimate, group = outlet, color = outlet)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.3, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.05) +
    geom_point(size = 5) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Outlet",
      values = c(Sun = "#B22222", NP = "#1B4F72"),
      labels = c(Sun = "The Sun", NP = "The New York Post")
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Pre", "Post"),
                      labels = c(Pre = "Pre-ChatGPT", Post = "Post-ChatGPT")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Topic ", i, " coverage: The Sun vs New York Post"),
      subtitle = "Topic proportion, pre vs post ChatGPT launch (Nov 2022)",
      x = NULL, y = "Share of Mentions across Articles"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  topic_plot_dfs[[paste0("topic", i)]] <- plot_df
  topic_graphs[[paste0("topic", i)]]   <- g
}



all_plot_df <- bind_rows(topic_plot_dfs, .id = "topic") |>
  mutate(
    period      = factor(period, levels = c("Pre", "Post")),
    topic_num   = as.integer(gsub("topic", "", topic)),
    topic_label = factor(paste0("Topic ", topic_num), levels = paste0("Topic ", 0:13))
  )

facet_sun= facet_graph <- ggplot(all_plot_df, aes(x = period, y = estimate, group = outlet, color = outlet)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.05) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Outlet",
    values = c(Sun = "#B22222", NP = "#1B4F72"),
    labels = c(Sun = "The Sun", NP = "New York Post")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Pre", "Post"),
                    labels = c(Pre = "Pre-ChatGPT", Post = "Post-ChatGPT")) + scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Pre", "Post"), labels = c(Pre = "Pre", Post = "Post")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~ topic_label, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Topic coverage: The Sun vs New York Post",
    subtitle = "Topic proportion, pre vs post ChatGPT launch (Nov 2022)",
    x = NULL, y = "Share of Mentions across Articles"
  ) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8)
  )

facet_graph
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

library(ggplot2)
library(sandwich)
```

```{r}
ft_full  <- full_pre_reference |> filter(outlet == "FT")
wsj_full <- full_pre_reference |> filter(outlet == "WSJ")

check_separation <- function(data, topic_col) {
  data |>
    group_by(period) |>

  min_nonzero_wsj = sapply(0:13, function(i) check_separation(wsj_full, paste0("topic_", i)))
) |>

    needs_lpm_ft  = min_nonzero_ft  <= 2,

  models_ft[[paste0("topic", i, "_ft")]] <- if (use_lpm_ft) {
    lm(f, data = ft_full)
  } else {
    glm(f, family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"), data = ft_full)
  }

  models_wsj[[paste0("topic", i, "_wsj")]] <- if (use_lpm_wsj) {
    lm(f, data = wsj_full)
  } else {
    glm(f, family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"), data = wsj_full)

}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

sun_full    <- full_pre_reference |> filter(outlet == "Sun")
npost_full  <- full_pre_reference |> filter(outlet == "NP")

npost_full <- npost_full |> mutate(year = factor(as.character(year), levels = all_years))

CUTOFF_YEAR <- 2022

check_separation <- function(data, topic_col) {
  data |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarise(n_nonzero = sum(.data[[topic_col]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    pull(n_nonzero) |>
    min()  # smallest nonzero count across all years
}

separation_flags <- tibble(
  topic = topic_ids,
  min_nonzero_sun = sapply(topic_ids, function(i) check_separation(sun_full, paste0("topic_", i))),
  min_nonzero_np  = sapply(topic_ids, function(i) check_separation(npost_full, paste0("topic_", i)))
) |>
  mutate(
    needs_lpm_sun = min_nonzero_sun <= 2,
    needs_lpm_np  = min_nonzero_np  <= 2
  )

print(separation_flags)


models_sun <- list()
models_np  <- list()

for (i in topic_ids) {
  f <- as.formula(paste0("topic_", i, " ~ year"))

  use_lpm_sun <- separation_flags$needs_lpm_sun[separation_flags$topic == i]
  use_lpm_np  <- separation_flags$needs_lpm_np[separation_flags$topic == i]

  models_sun[[paste0("topic", i, "_sun")]] <- if (use_lpm_sun) {
    lm(f, data = sun_full)
  } else {
    glm(f, family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"), data = sun_full)
  }

  models_np[[paste0("topic", i, "_np")]] <- if (use_lpm_np) {
    lm(f, data = npost_full)
  } else {
    glm(f, family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"), data = npost_full)
  }
}



get_year_estimates <- function(model, outlet_label, years) {

  year_levels <- as.character(years)          # e.g. "2020".."2025"
  newdata <- data.frame(year = factor(year_levels, levels = year_levels))

  if (inherits(model, "lm") && !inherits(model, "glm")) {
    b <- coef(model)
    Xnew_full <- model.matrix(~ year, data = newdata, na.action = na.pass)
    missing_cols <- setdiff(names(b), colnames(Xnew_full))
    for (mc in missing_cols) Xnew_full <- cbind(Xnew_full, setNames(data.frame(0), mc))
    Xnew <- as.matrix(Xnew_full[, names(b), drop = FALSE])

    est <- as.vector(Xnew %*% b)
    V   <- vcovHC(model, type = "HC1")
    se  <- sqrt(rowSums((Xnew %*% V) * Xnew))

    tibble(
      outlet    = outlet_label,
      year      = factor(year_levels, levels = year_levels),   # <- factor, not integer
      estimate  = est,
      conf.low  = est - 1.96 * se,
      conf.high = est + 1.96 * se
    )

  } else {
    pred <- predict(model, newdata = newdata, type = "link",
                     se.fit = TRUE, na.action = na.pass)

    tibble(
      outlet    = outlet_label,
      year      = factor(year_levels, levels = year_levels),   # <- factor, not integer
      estimate  = plogis(pred$fit),
      conf.low  = plogis(pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit),
      conf.high = plogis(pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit)
    )
  }
}

n_df <- bind_rows(
  sun_full   |> count(year) |> mutate(outlet = "Sun"),
  npost_full |> count(year) |> mutate(outlet = "NP")
)

topic_graphs   <- list()
topic_plot_dfs <- list()

for (i in topic_ids) {
  sun_model   <- models_sun[[paste0("topic", i, "_sun")]]
  npost_model <- models_np[[paste0("topic", i, "_np")]]

  if (is.null(sun_model) || is.null(npost_model)) {
    warning(paste("Missing model for topic", i, "- skipping"))
    next
  }

  plot_df <- bind_rows(
    get_year_estimates(sun_model, "Sun", all_years),
    get_year_estimates(npost_model, "NP", all_years)
  ) |> left_join(n_df, by = c("year", "outlet"))

  g <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = year, y = estimate, group = outlet, color = outlet)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = which(all_years == CUTOFF_YEAR) + 0.5,
               linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.3, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.05) +
    geom_point(size = 5) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Outlet",
      values = c(Sun = "#B22222", NP = "#1B4F72"),
      breaks = c("Sun", "NP"),                                    # <- controls legend order
  labels = c(Sun = "The Sun", NP = "The New York Post")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Topic ", i, " coverage: The Sun vs New York Post"),
      subtitle = "Topic proportion by year (dashed line = ChatGPT launch, Nov 2022)",
      x = NULL, y = "Share of Mentions across Articles"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  topic_plot_dfs[[paste0("topic", i)]] <- plot_df
  topic_graphs[[paste0("topic", i)]]   <- g
}


all_plot_df <- bind_rows(topic_plot_dfs, .id = "topic") |>
```

```{r}
get_year_estimates <- function(model, outlet_label, years) {

  year_levels <- as.character(years)


  model_years <- if (inherits(model, "lm") && !inherits(model, "glm")) {
    levels(droplevels(model$model$year))
  } else {
    model$xlevels$year
  }

  usable_years   <- intersect(year_levels, model_years)
  unusable_years <- setdiff(year_levels, model_years)   # e.g. "2019" for NYT

  newdata <- data.frame(year = factor(usable_years, levels = model_years))

  if (inherits(model, "lm") && !inherits(model, "glm")) {
    b <- coef(model)
    Xnew_full <- model.matrix(~ year, data = newdata, na.action = na.pass)
    missing_cols <- setdiff(names(b), colnames(Xnew_full))
    for (mc in missing_cols) Xnew_full <- cbind(Xnew_full, setNames(data.frame(0), mc))
    Xnew <- as.matrix(Xnew_full[, names(b), drop = FALSE])

    est <- as.vector(Xnew %*% b)
    V   <- vcovHC(model, type = "HC1")
    se  <- sqrt(rowSums((Xnew %*% V) * Xnew))

    est_df <- tibble(year = usable_years, estimate = est,
                      conf.low = est - 1.96 * se, conf.high = est + 1.96 * se)

  } else {
    pred <- predict(model, newdata = newdata, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE)
    est_df <- tibble(
      year      = usable_years,
      estimate  = plogis(pred$fit),
      conf.low  = plogis(pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit),
      conf.high = plogis(pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit)
    )
  }

  na_df <- tibble(year = unusable_years, estimate = NA_real_,
                   conf.low = NA_real_, conf.high = NA_real_)

  bind_rows(est_df, na_df) |>
    mutate(outlet = outlet_label, year = factor(year, levels = year_levels)) |>
    arrange(year) |>
    relocate(outlet, year)
}
```

```{r}
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

facet_ft_wsj

n_topics <- length(topic_ids)
n_cols   <- 4
n_rows   <- ceiling(n_topics / n_cols)


```

## Word Representations 

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(kableExtra)


topic_cols <- grep("^topic_[0-9]+$", names(article_df), value = TRUE)
topic_ids  <- sort(as.integer(gsub("^topic_", "", topic_cols)))

topic_info <- topic_info |>
  mutate(
    topic = Topic,
    label = str_remove(Name, paste0("^", Topic, "_"))   # strips "17_" prefix -> "Trump's Trade Tariffs"
  ) |>
  select(topic, label)

get_top_headlines <- function(topic_id, data, n = 3) {
  col <- paste0("topic_", topic_id)

  data |>
    select(headline, proportion = all_of(col)) |>
    filter(proportion > 0) |>
    arrange(desc(proportion)) |>
    slice_head(n = n) |>
    mutate(topic = topic_id, rank = row_number()) |>
    select(topic, rank, headline, proportion)
}

headline_examples <- map_dfr(topic_ids, get_top_headlines, data = article_df, n = 3)



headline_table <- headline_examples |>
  left_join(topic_info, by = "topic") |>
  select(topic, label, rank, headline, proportion) |>
  arrange(topic, rank)

## Sanity check 
headline_table |> filter(is.na(label)) |> distinct(topic)

## Sanity check on a couple of topics
headline_table |> filter(topic %in% c(0, 17)) |> print(n = Inf)



headline_table_wide <- headline_table |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(topic, label),
    names_from = rank,
    values_from = headline,
    names_prefix = "headline_"
  ) |>
  arrange(topic)

print(headline_table_wide, n = Inf, width = Inf)


headline_table_wide |>
  mutate(topic = paste0("Topic ", topic)) |>
  kable(
    format = "latex",
    col.names = c("Topic", "Label", "Headline 1", "Headline 2", "Headline 3"),
    caption = "Topic labels with representative headlines",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    longtable = TRUE
  ) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "repeat_header"), font_size = 9) |>
  column_spec(3:5, width = "4.5cm")
```

```{r}
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +

)+
```
